# تَسْتَوْقِفِي (tastawqifī) /tas.taw.qi.fiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَوْقَفَ (istawqafa)
# تُسْتَوْقَفِي (tustawqafī) /tus.taw.qa.fiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَوْقَفَ (istawqafa)
